{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsor loadlifters''' were used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] salvage operation operating from the [[Imperial Salvage Station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]]. During the operation to salvage debris from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], repulsor loadlifters were used to move tagged wreckage out of Yavin's orbit to be collected by waiting cargo [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]].
